gold_note: Dromaeosaurid time tree. Multi-way nodes: Sinornithosaurus, the Graciliraptor-Microraptor node and the unenlagiine node; Graciliraptor with the two Microraptor species (stem entering at M. zhaoianus' height); Shanag, Neuquenraptor, Buitreraptor and Rahonavis; Achillobator, Adasaurus, Utahraptor and Dromaeosaurus.
